Today’s failing approach: course completion stands in for AI proficiency
donut_large
Completion dashboards
A completion rate records which employees finished the course. The dashboard cannot show which of them can complete a task with AI.
quiz
Knowledge quizzes
A multiple-choice quiz checks whether an employee can recall definitions and tool features. A correct answer does not show how the employee would handle a business task with AI.
rate_review
Self-assessment surveys
Employees rate their own confidence with AI tools. Self-ratings can vary from team to team. Your people team has no output to check the ratings against.
record_voice_over
Manager opinion
Managers name the people they believe use AI well. Different managers apply different standards, so the lists cannot be compared across teams.
None of these approaches gives your leadership team an output that an employee produced with AI.
An AI proficiency assessment for the employees you already have
Codility AI for Business assesses your current workforce in roles beyond engineering. AI for Business runs inside Skills Intelligence, Codility’s product for workforce skills assessment. Employees work in a simulated work environment with the AI Assistant. Your people team receives a scored result for each employee instead of a completion rate.
Give employees real tasks to complete with AI
A quiz question asks an employee about AI. In a Codility task, the employee receives a realistic brief and works with the AI Assistant. The employee then submits the output for scoring. You can assess employees in business functions including sales, marketing, customer support and finance.

Each employee’s result rests on an output the employee produced with AI.

Compare assessed results across teams
A completion dashboard shows the same status for every team that finished the course. Employees in different teams complete the same business tasks. Your people team can compare the scored results team by team.
Skills Intelligence integrates with more than 80 human resources information system (HRIS) platforms. Your people team can export results through the Open API.
When leadership asks who can get work done with AI, you can answer by team and by employee.
Trace each score to the output and the AI activity
A score assigned by a generative model can be difficult for your legal and assessment teams to explain. Codility scores each output deterministically against the set of acceptable answers that assessment experts defined for the task. The same output always receives the same score. Every interaction with the AI Assistant is captured as reviewable AI activity beside the result.
Your legal and assessment teams can check each score against the output and the AI activity behind it.

Frequently asked questions about AI proficiency assessment
An AI proficiency assessment is a test of whether a person can complete a task using AI. Codility AI for Business gives employees business tasks and scores the output each employee submits.
A knowledge quiz measures recall, and an AI proficiency test built on a task measures application. A free quiz can give an individual a quick check of their AI knowledge. For a result your leadership team can review, the employee needs to complete a task and submit an output.
No. The scoring is deterministic, and no generative model assigns the score.
Codility assesses business roles that use AI, including sales, marketing, customer support and finance. General workforce tasks cover roles outside those functions.
Your team does. Codility does not use AI or machine learning to make automated decisions about your employees.
